title: New hospital building, Brisbane: site establishment and traffic
workplace: New 10 storey hospital building with a two level basement and rooftop helipad, on an existing hospital campus next to the live hospital, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Hoardings next to the live hospital
swms.task: Erect the site fencing and hoardings between the site and the live hospital entrance and car park, with materials delivered by truck, and set up the site sheds, lifted into place by the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; the crane company's dogman slings and releases loads, and our licensed dogman receives and lands them with tag lines.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts
Work next to the live hospital

swms.title: Traffic management on the hospital campus
swms.task: Traffic controllers manage trucks, concrete trucks and mobile plant deliveries at the site gate on the hospital campus road next to the live hospital, open to traffic, keeping ambulance routes clear.

steps: Separate plant and people on site
Work next to the live hospital
